f1.notice: Official season standings sourced from the community-maintained Jolpica F1 API.

darts.notice: PDC Order of Merit live table. Rankings are updated after PDC ranking events.

ufc.notice: Official UFC divisional rankings from UFCalendar. Rank 0 denotes the champion; rankings are updated when the publisher releases a new snapshot.

boxing.notice: Current reigns from Open Boxing, covering the major sanctioning bodies and The Ring where recorded. Boxing title status can change between updates; data coverage is subject to the source database.

provider: Jolpica F1, Darts API, UFCalendar and Open Boxing
